Mia Chen: Heads up — drafting a lightweight competitive claims checklist for the next webinar + benchmark blog. Quick sanity check? Want to keep it punchy vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors.

Sam Patel: Love it. Focus on three claim pillars: latency SLOs, predictable unit economics, and deployment flexibility. Keep numbers conservative. e.g. '99% of steady-state requests served under X ms' — but we need backup. :thinking_face:

Elena Garcia: +1. We should avoid absolute 'faster than X' unless we have public benchmark side-by-side. Suggested phrasing: 'consistently lower median latency at scale, with tunable cost controls.' Legal will need to vet any comparative charts.

Ian O'Connell: For inbound routing: add tags like `bench-interested`, `dedicated-internal`, source=webinar. Route bench-interested -> AE/SDR queue B, auto-schedule demo slot within 48h. Also flag EU leads for GDPR consent capture.

Mia Chen: Draft checklist snippet below — please edit.
```
Checklist:
- Claim area (latency / cost / reliability / deployment)
- Evidence needed (bench CSV, traces, configuration)
- Owner (eng/product/fin)
- Legal sign-off needed? (Y/N)
- Routing tag for inbound (eg bench-interested)
- Follow-up timing (demo window / case study ask)
```

Sam Patel: Proposed owners: Latency -> Eng (load-test + traces). Cost -> Finance (sample pricing calc + assumptions). Deployment flexibility -> Product (matrix of hosted/dedicated/private). Add a small table for acceptable ranges (median 50-150ms, p95 target per tier).

Elena Garcia: Legal note: 'predictable' OK; avoid 'guarantee' unless it's SLA-backed for Dedicated. Also call out the exact dataset/config used in any public benchmark.

Ian O'Connell: Ops question — can we attach a sample ingest for the webinar landing page so SDRs can triage signal automatically? If yes, we'll add a webhook that sets `source=webinar` and `interest=benchmark`.

Mia Chen: Perfect — I'll update the deck and add a single-slide evidence appendix with links to raw bench artifacts. Planning to keep on-slide claims high-level and put details in the appendix + repo link. :thumbsup:

marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar rehearsal Thu 11:00. Motion: finalize narrative + checklist by Wed EOD.

Elena Garcia: I'll queue legal review for Wed morning.

Sam Patel: I'll collect eng traces and a short synopsis of test harness by Tue.

Ian O'Connell: I'll draft the inbound routing rules and demo scheduling flow by Wed afternoon.

Mia Chen: Thanks team — want to keep claims defensible but compelling. Ping me on thread if you need to reassign. :raised_hands:
